views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (type = 'in'::movement_type) THEN amount_minor
            ELSE (- amount_minor)
        END), (0)::numeric) AS cash_balance_minor
   FROM cash_movements cm
  GROUP BY user_id;
views.name: v_user_balances

views.definition:
SELECT mis.user_id,
    mis.item_id,
    i.name AS item_name,
    mis.year,
    mis.month,
    mis.quantity,
    mis.total_spending_minor,
    mis.usage_change_percentage
   FROM (monthly_item_statistics mis
     LEFT JOIN items i ON ((i.id = mis.item_id)));
views.name: v_monthly_item_summary
